_doc: Architecture guard config = the hexagonal contract. Signal 1 (domain noun / adapter-import in CORE) is a HARD FAIL. Signals 3 (core churn) and 7 (marginal cost + %-logic-in-md) are TREND metrics, reported not gated (co-evolution edits the core early; the alarm is a PLATEAU, not any single edit). Refining core-vs-adapter membership is itself part of the refactor.
